corrections.reason: In the Ge'ez patristic citation ('ህየንተ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ሠላሳ ፡ ወስሳ ፡ ወምእተ'), 'ሠላሳ' (thirty, matching L11 'ሠላሳ፡ ስሳ ፡ መቶ') has a faded central stroke on 'ሠ' that made it look like 'ወ'.
Removed stray wrap marker if any, verified 'ወኢበስእርተ' matches the printed glyphs on the page.
The verse range separator after ፴፬ before ፴፰ on the next line is a colon/preface colon.
In the reference to Matthew 5:34-37/38 (on oaths, 'ማቴ ፡ ፭ ፥ ፴፬-፴፰'), the tens numeral is '፴' (30), not '፶' (50); the bottom loop of '፴' is clearly visible.
